principle: Reason classification must not be used to launder or strengthen a governance outcome.

classes.description: The system cannot validly evaluate the artifact because required structure, syntax, integrity, or evaluability is broken.
A known mandatory governance or control requirement has been violated.
Available evidence is insufficient to support the required decision claim.
Evaluation is structurally valid, but action must pause because an operational or governance condition remains unresolved.
The verification mechanism itself encountered an internal failure that prevents a valid determination.

hard_rules: A reason identifier must not independently grant authority
Unregistered reasons must not silently map to a more permissive authority state
